steps.message:
feat(tally): hide rare words with --min-count

Long files print a tail of words seen once. --min-count drops words seen fewer than N times; the default of 1 keeps the output byte-identical.

feat(tally): count adjacent word pairs with --pairs

Some reports want the most common two-word phrases. --pairs counts adjacent pairs on each line, lowercased like single words, and honors --min-count.
